title: Crunchy
description:
Male | Senior | FCV+ and Stomatitis
Never been around dogs
Crunchy came to us in December 2023. He is currently our longest staying cat at the shelter. Crunchy is very old and therefore has very little energy. He is very mellow but also super sweet. He would be a perfect lap cat. 
Due to his FCV and stomatitis, he is on prednisone everyday. The meds make him thirsty and he drinks a ton of water.
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Cosco
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3 years) | FHV+
Never been around dogs
Cosco was brought in as a stray in early 2024. She was pregnant and eventually gave birth at the shelter. All of her kittens were adopted but unfortunately she is still here. She is one of our longest stays currently at the shelter. She is a total sweetheart and loves human interaction. 
She is FHV+ and would need to be an only cat. FHV isn’t as daunting as it sounds. There is no medication for FHV therefore her vet bills would be the same as any other cat! 
Cosco has a cloudy eye and it’s from a scratch that healed. There’s no issue with it!

title: Sophie
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3-5 years) | FIV+
Preferably only cat. Indoor only. Never been around dogs.
Sophie came in as a stray in January 2025. She is the perfect mix of sweet and sassy. She loves pets but will let you know when she wants her space. She has warmed up to having neighboring cats but would probably do best as the only cat. She is FIV+ so she would need to be indoors only. She has not shown any physical symptoms/health issues from the FIV. It was only discovered through routine testing.

title: Domino
description:
Male | Born late 2024/early 2025
Never been around dogs
The WHHS took in Domino from the reservation in April 2025. Since he came in, he’s been very reserved and keeps to himself. But 2026 might be his year - he’s started to come out of his shell and make his presence known! He’ll gladly take pets and would do better in a calmer home without many animals or kids. He’ll accept pets and when he’s decided he’s finished, he’ll either walk away but sometimes gets salty with a swat, but hey, he’s a cat…

title: Twilight
description:
Female | 1+ year
Never been around dogs
Twilight was born at the shelter on May 1, 2025. She is the last of her 4 siblings still at the shelter. She is a very relaxed and gentle girl but is getting more and more outgoing (coming up to greet visitors) every day. She is in the cattery and likes to snuggle with the other cats. She’ll gladly take any pets that come her way.

title: Ellie
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3 years)
Never been around dogs
Ellie came in as a stray in June 2025. Since then she has really opened up. She is quite curious and likes to explore. Ellie loves getting attention and pets as well - she’s absolutely gorgeous and we aren’t sure why she is still with us. Consider adding this beauty to your family!

title: Tabby
description:
Female | ~1-2 years
Never been around dogs
Tabby came to us as a stray in August 2025. She has become more social and affectionate recently and we are so happy to see her happy! But, she would sure be happier in a loving home and out of the kennel. We hope you come and fall in love with this gorgeous gal!

title: Finn
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~2 years)
Never been around dogs
Finn came in as a stray in October 2025. Since his first day here, he has been extremely sweet. He is in our cattery with other cats and does well. You’ll often find him snuggled up in a bed but will get up to come greet you.

title: Cleo Catra
description:
Female | Born April 2022
No other animals | Indoor only
Cleo Catra came to us on 3.27.26. She is a sweet girl that adores pets and is just a little unsure in her new environment. Cleo does not like other animals and will pee on things if other animals are present in the home. She does not like big groups so would do best in a quiet home with fewer people. She might not do well with younger children. She is affectionate to her human and it was a hard surrender for her former owner. Orange females are rare and she’s a total catch.

title: Esmeralda
description:
Female | Born 9/10/2015
No young children, preferably no other pets
Esmeralda and her grey Tortie sister, Eleanor, were brought to us on April 4th, 2026. Their parents were expecting a baby and these cats are not fans of children (many attempts were made to get to know kiddos in the family) so they came to us. Esmeralda does lick when she’s stressed so she has some bald patches or spots with thin hair - she’s still a beauty though! Esmeralda would love to join an adult or two in a quiet home. The sisters don’t get along that well and if adopted together, would likely keep their distance in their new home. 
Esmeralda will come with her automatic feeder when adopted.
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Eleanor
description:
Female | Born 9/10/2015
No young children, no other pets
Eleanor and her Tortie sister, Esmeralda, were brought to us on April 4th, 2026. Their parents were expecting a baby and these cats are not fans of children (many attempts were made to get to know kiddos in the family) so they came to us. Eleanor is a little spicy and would do best in a quiet home with only a few adults that respected her space - she’ll come to you when she wants affection. The sisters don’t get along that well and if adopted together, would likely keep their distance in their new home. 
Eleanor will come with her automatic feeder when adopted. 
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Prego
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~5 years)
No dogs, preferably no cats
Hailey’s favorite kitty! Prego came to us as a pregnant stray in January 2026. She gave birth to 4 healthy babies and they have all been adopted. Like her, they were all named after sauces! Prego is an extremely affectionate cat with a bobtail that enjoys watching out the window, growling at anything out of the ordinary - she’d make a great guard dog! Prego loves to be pet, enjoys lounging around, and is always eager to say “hello!” She is currently in the cattery in her own kennel, where she has more room to roam and to be around other cats and we are curious if she’ll warm up to other kitties now that she doesn’t have kittens. Prego enjoys giving humans kisses!

title: Smores
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~1 year)
Might do well with an older or chill cat & might do well with a small dog. Top pick of hers would be to be the only pet. 
Smores came in with her kittens, Kamp and Fyre, on 5.26.26 after being dumped out on some property. She is happy to be away from her needy boys and relaxing after all her hard work as a mom. She does not appear to like other cats very much and does not like dogs. She’s a real people lover though! Nothing would make her happier than to nap in your lap!

title: Lawrence
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~2 years)
Never been around dogs, unsure how he does with other cats
Lawrence came to us on 5.26.26 after living as a stray. He is a little feisty but is up front to try to work on socializing. The family that kept tabs on him said he was a sweet kitty that they could hold so we look forward to meeting this version of him!

title: Spino
description:
Male | Born 4/1/2015
Has lived with dogs & other cats
Spino came to us at 11 years old in June 2026. He is a senior that is taking time to adjust but we are looking forward to getting to know this sweet older boy. He’ll be in our senior room and we’ve love for you to come fall for this big hunk. 
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Chongus
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~1-3 years old)
Not a fan of big dogs, likes puppies, unsure how he will do around other cats
Chongus came to us as a stray and we believed him to be feral. He’s not feral at all but he’s pretty scared. He’s a giant sweetie that would do well in a quiet home where he can come out of his shell.

title: Zeus
description:
Male | Maine Coon Mix | 13 years old 
Diabetic, needing insulin every 12 hours. Currently being fostered. Please reach out to schedule a meet-and-greet!
Front declaw - indoor only!
Zeus is a Maine Coon mix - a BIG boy! He’s an older gentlemen that needs some TLC and he will be visiting the groomer on 7/8/26 for a much needed shave and bath. He’ll be feeling fresh and looking for his forever home. He has lived with cats, dogs, and children. He does get defensive with dogs if they are too “up-in-his-business.”
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Mia
description:
Female | Born 2021
Never been around dogs
Mia came to us with 5 other cats in April 2026. Her owner was unable to care for them and it took awhile for us to gain ownership of them. We’ve gotten to know them over the last few months and they are all so sweet and FINALLY ready to go to a new home! Mia is very cuddly (as you can see in this photo) and would love to fall in love with her new human.

title: Canyon
description:
Female | Born 2024
Never been around dogs
Canyon came to us with 5 other cats in April 2026. Her owner was unable to care for them and it took awhile for us to gain ownership of them. We’ve gotten to know them over the last few months and they are all so sweet and FINALLY ready to go to a new home! Canyon has big beautiful eyes and is a bit more timid. But like her “sisters” she warms up to people and is a sweetheart once she’s comfortable.

title: Pinto
description:
Male | Born 2025
Never been around dogs
Pinto came to us with 5 other cats in April 2026. His owner was unable to care for them and it took awhile for us to gain ownership of them. We’ve gotten to know them over the last few months and they are all so sweet and FINALLY ready to go to a new home! Pinto came to us with no name, so we thought he and his sister made a cute “Pinto” and “Bean.” Pinto is sweet, outgoing, and a snuggle buddy. Take this handsome man home!

title: Bean
description:
Female | Born 2025
Never been around dogs
Bean came to us with 5 other cats in April 2026. Her owner was unable to care for them and it took awhile for us to gain ownership of them. We’ve gotten to know them over the last few months and they are all so sweet and FINALLY ready to go to a new home! Bean came to us with no name, so we thought her and her brother made a cute “Pinto” and “Bean.” Bean is a little shy meeting all these new people, but she’s extremely sweet and oozing with love. She’s excited to shed some kennel weight running around her new home!

title: Liberty Bell
description:
Female | Est. Born 2024-2025
Liberty Bell came to us a pregnant stray in May of 2026. She gave birth to 6 beautiful babies and has been a wonderful mom. Liberty warms up to other cats just fine and doesn’t mind small dogs. She’s ready to start her new life… maybe it’s with you!

title: Cascade
description:
Female | Born 2025
Never been around dogs
Cascade came to us in July 2026 with 4 babies. She is a just a baby herself, definitely not a year old. She’s got that grumpy face but she is a sweet pea, just a little shy. A quiet home would be best for this gal. She does warm up to other cats, especially older ones and she isn’t too upset by the presence of small dogs.

title: Jalapeno
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~1-2 years old) 
Never been around dogs, unsure of how he will do with other cats
Jalapeno gave to us in June as a spicy stray. It was all a front because this guy is actually pretty sweet. He’s a bit shy but does enjoy pets - he will even start drooling. He’d do best with a patient human in a quiet home. He does have his ear notched as we weren’t sure if he’d need to go to a shop/barn but he’s proved to us he’s adoptable and ready for a furever home!

title: Dough Trader
description:
Male | Born ~ 4/28/26
Weary of dogs
Dough Trader and his pizza party brother and sister came to us at the end of June 2026. They were a bit spicy and like to act tough, but these cuties are warming up to pets and affections. Dough Trader is a fluffy one of the bunch. 
Kittens under 6 months are a $100 adoption fee.

title: Sawyer
description:
Female | Born ~4/28/26
Weary of dogs
Sawyer and her pizza party brothers came to us at the end of June 2026. They were a bit spicy and like to act tough, but these cuties are warming up to pets and affections. Sawyer is the only girl out of her litter. 
Kittens under 6 months are a $100 adoption fee.

title: Pikes
description:
Male | Born ~5/29/26 
Application Pending
Needs a slow introduction to dogs
A mountain babe to Cascade, our mountain mama. These kitties arrived in July 2026 and are playful, but also quite lazy. Pikes is the most adventurous of the litter. The boys in this litter are about twice the size of their sisters!

title: Denali
description:
Female | Born ~5/29/26 
Waiting for CH diagnosis & spay // will be available to meet soon
A mountain babe to Cascade, our mountain mama. Denali has extra toes on her front feet! These kitties arrived in July 2026 and are playful, but also quite lazy. Denali loves to snuggle with her brother, Teton. The girls in the litter are quite petite, about half the size of their brothers.

title: Shasta
description:
Female | Born ~5/29/26 
Waiting for CH diagnosis & spay // will be available to meet soon!
A mountain babe to Cascade, our mountain mama. Shasta has extra toes on her front feet! These kitties arrived in July 2026 and are playful, but also quite lazy. The girls in the litter are quite petite, about half the size of their brothers.

title: Nova
description:
Female | Australian Shepherd Mix | 6 yrs
No young children(12+), No cats
Nova is back from her foster adventure! We learned that she really will do best with only one human in the house and being the only pet. She still needs slow introductions even when in her new home. She had great manners without accidents in her foster home and was not destructive so she would not need to be kenneled when left home alone. Please ask questions and we’d be happy to get you in touch with her former foster dad if you want to get to know her more! 
Our longest term resident! Nova was brought in with a male dog and a puppy in 2022, though she remains. Being in the shelter for so long has made her reactive and sassy, therefore she requires a slow introduction. For most new introductions we muzzle her to keep everyone safe. Once she is comfortable with you, she is very affectionate. We call her “Our Princess.” 
She does not get along with female dogs but has shown little to no aggression towards male dogs. Give her some time, you’ll love her as much as we do! 
Nova weighs around 30 pounds.
Nova's adoption fee is $75 since she's been a long term resident and is approaching her senior years.

title: Lilac
description:
Female | Coohound Mix | Born 8/5/2022
No young kids(12+) or elderly, no cats, some dogs *would do best with single female & no other pets
This pretty lady came to us on 4/7/2026. She is a great dog who is just a bit particular. She’s not a big fan of some people (some men, some elderly) and does not get along with all dogs in a household setting. Lilac has been to doggy daycare in Rapid City at Meadowridge Pet Lodge, and gets along with dogs in a neutral setting. She has some separation anxiety and can be a bit destructive when left home alone, though she hasn’t shown any destructive behavior spending nights with one of our employees. She is not a fan of small children. If you have further question regarding Lilac, please reach out through our email. 
Lilac weighs around 50 lbs.

title: Gus
description:
Male | Lab Mix | ~8 years
Good w/ dogs that give him space, unsure of cats
Gus was brought to us on 4/24/26 as a stray. He’s a very sweet and well-mannered ole boy, though he likes to jump up on you when he’s excited! We aren’t sure of his age - his face says 10 but the vet guesses 8 - regardless of age, Gus gets around great! He jumps into cars, runs to his kennel, and digs to his hearts content! We aren’t sure how he feels about cats (seems like he’s hunting them but might just be curious,) yet seems fine with his neighboring dogs as long as he has plenty of space. 
Gus weighs about 74 lbs. 
Gus is a senior & available for a senior rate. Give us a call or come meet him!

title: Cutlass
description:
Male | Heeler/Doberman Mix | Born 3/8/23
No cats, no male dogs, no small kids(12+)
Cutlass came to us on 4/30/26 after his owner passed away. We think he would do best with older kids, a fenced yard, and/or living with someone who is very active. Cutlass has a lot of energy to burn and absolutely loves the water! He’s a lake or creek playing dog for sure. Cutlass is a little finicky upon new introductions, he’s quite tough with a kennel between you and he, but once he warms up, he’s a real hambone. We invite you to come visit him and see if you could be his next best friend!
Cutlass weighs 50 lbs.

title: Guster
description:
Male | Shepherd Mix | Born 2025
No cats, some dogs, great with kids
Guster (formally Junior) is back! Guster is a squeak-ectomy champion, a lover of hard squeaker toys, a digger, and a jumper! He’s a full-time busy body! Guster does very well with younger kids but would probably be best as the only pet. Guster’s previous adopters learned that he and the cat and did not get along, and neither did one of their family members who owns dogs outside of their house. If you have another dog, we would love to facilitate a meet-and-greet before adopting out!
Guster weighs 40 lbs.

title: Harlequinn
description:
Female | Lab/Pit Mix | Born 3/20/24
No other dogs, unsure of cats
Harlequinn and her “sister,” Akasha, are with us after not being able to return home. (Though they came together, do not need adopted out together.) Harley is a sweet but reserved gal. She’ll give you a full body dog kiss bath! Although she gets along with Akasha, doesn’t seem to be a big fan of other dogs and would probably chase cats if given the chance. Harley is a lover of people and jumps up on you when she’s excited! She is a sweet cuddler and loves to go on car rides! Harley has a hematoma on her neck and requires harnessing.
Harlequinn weighs 48 pounds

title: Mocha
description:
Female | English Mastador/Lab Mix | Born 2025
Some dogs, unsure of cats (but would probably recommend no cats)
Mocha and her sister, Shyra, came to us on 6/4/26 after their owner could no longer care for them. (Though sisters, do not need adopted together.) Mocha is the more confident of the two. She is a big goofball who uses her whole head for drinks of water! Lover of bones and hard toys, destroyer of fluffy toys! Mocha is gaining more confidence by going on more walks and having her independence from Shyra. We think Mocha would get along with other dogs, but a meet-and-greet would need to be set up! 
Mocha weighs around 90 pounds.

title: Phoenix
description:
Male | Shepherd/Akita/Kelpie Mix | 1+ year old
Seems fine with other dogs, unsure of cats (but his siblings have done fine w/ cats!)
Phoenix is the most brave and excited to meet people. He opened up to us pretty quickly and continues to be a good boy with a crooked gaze! He loves to go on walks and get outside for exercise! He is the last of the Mythicals here at the shelter.
Phoenix weighs 52 lbs.
Phoenix came to us the week of June 21st, 2026 with 7 other dogs. They were involved in a house explosion in the early morning of June 21st. There were 17 dogs total and all dogs (and humans) survived. All dogs have singed fur but thankfully, only a couple had severe injuries. We don’t know their former names and any other history than potential breed mixes. We do know they lived with children.

title: Droopy
description:
Male | Corgi/Beagle | Born 5/30/26
10 week old puppy who is full of energy! He plays hard for a few minutes and then sleeps for hours. He’s full of puppy teeth, puppy breath, and spunk. Little man is already showing some signs of potty training and is eating both hard and soft food. He loves to chew on anything in reach! Cords, books, shoes, laces, and anything else, he’s a true pup! 
Right now, he weighs about 5 pounds, but will likely grow into a 35-50 pound dog. 
Puppies are $200 + $150 refundable neuter fee = $362.40 after tax

title: Toby
description:
Male | Yellow Lab Mix | Around 2 years
Seems to get along with dogs, cats unknown, loves people 
Toby came to us as a stray. A lovely lady picked him up and took care of him for a while before being brought to the shelter. Unfortunately no one has stepped forward to claim me! I am a lover of people, I just want to cuddle and go on walks. 
Toby weighs 52 pounds!
